title: Twelve Winters and One Short Path
subtitle: 成长经历 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成长经历（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：成长经历（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：experience　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 experience 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my aunt ① had an experience that no traveller in the valley would have described, and she said the having was the whole of the winter. The ② experience, meaning the event itself and not the story, ran twelve winters and stayed undescribed in the book; an experience, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ experience in that valley had the same short path beside it, and the ④ experience at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the summer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An experience, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my aunt said the describing is the part that fills twelve winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the experience was the whole of the trade, meaning the skill and not the event. The ⑥ experience, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a trade that everybody waits for and nobody describes; experience, he said, is either something you have or the only word that means both an event and skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ experience had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short path. The ⑧ experience of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one valley and twelve winters of describing; experience, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ experience I remember is the one described in the journal, which closed in 1963 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. An ⑩ experience, my mother said in 1965, is the only one that improves by being described; every experience, she said, is skill that has agreed to look like an event. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 经历；体验（指山谷里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 经历（指那一次本身，与故事相对）
C. 固定搭配：have an experience 有一次经历
D. n. 经历（指留给夏天的那一次）
E. n. 经历（抽象总称，指一个山谷里的历练之事）
F. n. 经历（指日志上写到、被写下的那一次）
G. n. 经验；阅历（指一门行当里人人都等却无人写下的那样东西）
H. n. 经验（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人写下的那样东西）

items.q: had an experience that no traveller in the valley would have described
The experience, meaning the event itself and not the story
the experience at the far side
the experience was the whole of the trade
the experience had become a line in a journal
The experience of the whole thing
An experience, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: have an experience 意为“有一次经历”，1949 年姑姑有一次山谷里没有一位旅人肯写下的经历。
experience 意为“经历”，指那一次本身而不是故事，它经过了十二个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
experience 意为“经历”，指山谷里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一条短短的小路。
experience 意为“经历”，指留给夏天的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
experience 意为“经验、阅历”，指一门行当里人人都等却无人写下的那样东西，叔叔说这份经验就是那门行当的全部。
experience 意为“经验”，指人人都等却无人写下的那样东西而不是那一次经历，是行当里人人都等、却无人写下的东西。
experience 意为“经历”，指日志上写到、被写下的那一次，到 1958 年这一次成了日志里的一行。
experience 意为“经历”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的历练之事是一个山谷和十二个冬天的写下。
experience 意为“经历”，我记得的是日志上写下的那一次，1963 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一次。
experience 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，一次经历是唯一会因为被好好写下而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年姑姑有一次山谷里没有一位旅人肯写下的经历，她说经历才是那个冬天的全部。（have an experience）
那次经历，指的是那一次本身而不是故事，经过了十二个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。（experience）
那个山谷里每一次经历旁边都有同一条短短的小路。（experience）
远处那一端经历，指的是她们留给夏天的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（experience）
叔叔说这份经验就是那门行当的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那一次经历。（experience）
1965 年母亲说，一次经历是唯一会因为被好好写下而变得更好的东西。（experience）
